messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick pulse — planning staggered cutover for API v2 deprecation starting 2025-05-15. Three waves: 1) hosted canary, 2) SDKs + client libs, 3) private clusters. Need owners and blockers. Who's taking wave 2 (SDK coordination + compatibility)? Also share list of known incompatible SDK versions. https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v2-cutover
Tom R.: I'll take wave 2 lead for runtime + native SDKs. Need clarity on fallback semantics (should incompatible requests 503 or route to v1 shim?).
Maya Patel: I can own docs/migration guide updates. Quick Q — are we removing the legacy query param `model=` or leaving a short-lived shim?
Jorge M.: JS SDK here. We have 2 open PRs; streaming tests fail on canary profile. Planning to cut 1.5.0 with breaking changes if unavoidable. Need matrix of server variants to test against.
Jorge M.: failing log snippet:
```
FAIL: stream.test.js › should close KV cache on reconnect
  Error: stream ended unexpectedly
```
Aisha Khan: Decision: keep the `model=` shim for 30 days after cutover. Fallback policy: incompatible clients should receive 503 by default; we will provide an opt-in route->v1 shim for select enterprise customers. @infra-bot can you confirm canary routing policy?
infra-bot: routing update: canary slice=0.05, fallback=route->v1-on-shim, canary start=2025-05-15T10:00:00Z. Health checks: 30s probes. :white_check_mark:
QA - Lin: I can run the full regression against the canary once we have the SDK artifacts and the server matrix. Please add a test matrix (node versions, streaming on/off, kv-cache enabled/disabled).
Tom R.: I'll tag CI builds for PRs. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/builds/412 and https://ci.redwood/builds/418. Both include streaming fixes; PR #418 is the hotfix branch.
Maya Patel: Docs checklist I will own: migration guide, changelog, deprecation FAQ, sample app migration, and a short 'what to expect' for customers. Draft by EOD Friday.
Aisha Khan: Ownership summary so far — Wave1: infra oncall (Derek), Wave2: Tom R. (lead) + Maya Patel + Jorge M., Wave3: Platform SRE (Emma). Please update the migration owners doc and add follow-ups: slack thread + runbook link.
Jorge M.: heads-up: runtime behavior — older JS SDKs send empty `client_metadata` object; v2 currently treats that as invalid. Suggest adding a tolerance shim that treats `{}` as absent.
Tom R.: good catch. I'll add a compatibility patch in runtime to treat empty `client_metadata` as optional. Will ship as hotfix to canary. Low-risk change.
QA - Lin: Once hotfix is in canary, I'll run `npm run smoke:canary` and post results. Expect ~20m for full suite.
Emma: ack, I'll monitor platform SLOs during canary window. If error budget spikes, we abort.
Derek: infra oncall here — prepping capacity and rollback playbook. Need confirmation on A/B rollback path for private clusters.
Aisha Khan: Derek — please add rollback steps to the runbook and confirm in runbook page. Also update the SLA matrix for customers on private deployments.
Tom R.: tagging follow-ups: - add compatibility patch to runtime (PR soon) - coordinate with Jorge to re-run streaming tests - post artifacts to CI link above
Maya Patel: will start docs PR and add migration checklist items as TODOs.
QA - Lin: will subscribe to build artifacts and kick tests once artifacts posted.
Aisha Khan: thanks all. Next async check-in: Tue 2025-05-13 16:00 UTC. If anything blocks before then, ping #eng-oncall and drop updates here. :rocket:
